connector.name: Word Is Bond
connector.registryDescription: Test the voice agents you run: scored transcripts, pass/fail verdicts, latency and WER metrics.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.wordis-bond.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the latimer-woods-tech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for a Word Is Bond API key. Create one at https://studio.wordis-bond.com — the free Starter plan needs no card. `initialize` and `tools/list` work without it; `tools/call` requires it.
